verdict.line: You lose if you let Cho'Gath land Rupture into Feral Scream on cooldown and farm Vorpal Spikes damage for free; you win every all-in once you reach level 6 Realm of Death and he has no reliable disengage.

brief.thesis: Mordekaiser's 55.3% win rate over 208 games comes from out-scaling Cho'Gath's poke once Darkness Rise is active — Cho'Gath has no way to break Mordekaiser's passive aura or kite him off once Death's Grasp lands. The lane is a patience check: Cho'Gath wants to land Q (Rupture) into Vorpal Spikes stacks before trades, Mordekaiser wants to walk Cho'Gath down and force a stand-still fight where his own passive and sustain win.

theirWindow.what: He will try to land Rupture at 950 range to pop and slow you before autoing you down with Vorpal Spikes. Don't walk up in a straight line through brush or minions when his Q is up — it has a 9s cooldown so punish the 9 seconds after he whiffs or uses it to farm.

yourWindow.when: his Q (Rupture) is down, you have Darkness Rise
yourWindow.what: Close the gap immediately and commit to Obliterate and Death's Grasp. With no Rupture to create space and no hard disengage, he's forced to trade autos into your passive aura and your W (Indestructible) shield, which is a losing exchange for him.

powerCurve.note: Vorpal Spikes and Rupture poke before your passive is online
Death's Grasp lets you punish his Rupture misses
Realm of Death removes his kite options entirely
Rylai's slow locks him in Obliterate range
Riftmaker/Liandry's DPS outlasts his true-damage Feast

start.item: Doran's Ring + Health Potion + Health Potion
start.why: Taken in 75.2% of games (50% win rate over 200 games) — the extra sustain from two potions matters because Cho'Gath's Vorpal Spikes chip you every time you trade autos, and the mana regen keeps Obliterate and Death's Grasp available for punish windows.

boots.why: 58.8% win rate over 153 games and the top pick at 62.2% — the tenacity shortens how long Feral Scream's silence locks you out of W (Indestructible) during his all-in attempts.

core.why: First item in the top build path (62.5% win rate, 18% pick) — the slow from Obliterate and Death's Grasp keeps Cho'Gath inside your passive aura instead of kiting with Vorpal Spikes autos.
Second in the 18%-pick path — the omnivamp and % max HP burn out-sustain his Carnivore healing from minion kills.
Closes out the top build path — stacking burn punishes him for standing in melee range to use Vorpal Spikes, which he has to do since it only triggers on his own autos.

situational.when: he's building Feast stacks and out-sustaining your trades with Carnivore healing
he's rushing on-hit items instead of straight AP, since his damage is from Vorpal Spikes autos

runes.keystoneWhy: The stacking adaptive damage and healing on fully stacked Conqueror outlasts Vorpal Spikes chip damage in extended trades, which is exactly the fight Mordekaiser wants to force.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite is run in 77% of games at a 49.8% win rate — Ignite's sustained damage secures the all-in once Realm of Death (R) locks Cho'Gath down at level 6, denying any Carnivore healing off a kill elsewhere on the map.

playing.title: Hold Death's Grasp for his Rupture miss
playing.detail: E (Death's Grasp) pulls all enemies in its area at 700 range. Save it for the moment after his Q (Rupture) whiffs or goes on its 9s cooldown, since that's when he has no tool to escape the pull.

playing.title: Trade only with Darkness Rise active
playing.detail: Your passive triggers after 3 attacks or spells land on him, giving a damage aura and move speed. Bait his autos or poke with Obliterate first so the passive is live before you commit to the stand-still fight.

playing.title: Use Indestructible before Vorpal Spikes trades
playing.detail: W (Indestructible) stores damage dealt and taken into a shield you can pop to heal. Activate it before walking into his auto range so the Vorpal Spikes chip feeds your heal instead of just draining your HP bar.

playing.title: All-in the instant you hit level 6
playing.detail: R (Realm of Death) drags him into your dimension at 650 range and steals a share of his stats, removing his only way to disengage. Cho'Gath has no dash or blink, so this is close to a guaranteed kill window if his Flash is down.

playing.title: Don't facecheck brush before his Q is tracked
playing.detail: Rupture has 950 range and pops you up with a slow, which sets up a free Feral Scream silence. Approach through minion waves, not open lane, until you've seen him use Q.

playing.title: Punish Feast on cooldown
playing.detail: R (Feast) has a 60s cooldown and only 175 range — melee only. Once he's used it on a minion or missed it on you, he has no true-damage burst available and is markedly weaker in the follow-up trade.

playing.title: Don't contest early minion trades for stacks
playing.detail: Carnivore heals him off any unit kill, and Vorpal Spikes trigger passively on his autos. Let him have early CS trades and focus on scaling into your level 6-8 power spike instead of fighting on his terms.

brief.patchCaveat: Build order, runes, summoners, and the 55.3% over 208 games head-to-head win rate are measured from live OP.GG data on the current patch (16.20.1); the mechanical reasoning and trade timing are my own tactical read of the ability kits.

stats.opponentTip: Avoid Cho’Gath’s (Q) when fighting him. Keep your [P] active while fighting him to gain the upper hand.
